items.context: Do you want to keep the product or return it?
items.text: nahin chahiye
mera order number 123456 hai refund chahiye
maine kal product receive kiya tha lekin defective tha
please batao refund process kab complete hoga
kya mujhe return ke liye pickup arrange karna padega
order cancel karna hai kyunki product pasand nahi aaya
kya refund me full amount milega ya kuch deduction hoga

items.context: What is the reason for the return?
items.text: mai item return karna chahta hu kyunki galat colour aaya hai

items.context: How can I cancel my order?
items.text: order cancel karne ke liye aapko form fill karna padega

items.context: When will you receive your refund?
items.text: refund amount mujhe kab tak mil jayega please batao

items.context: Did you use any coupon code while ordering?
items.text: kupon code nahi laga sake isliye discount nahi mila

items.context: Did you inspect the product after delivery?
items.text: maine product khol kar check bhi kiya tha defective hai
mera order 15 March ko deliver hua tha lekin item bilkul kaam nahi kar raha hai mujhe return karna hai aur refund chahiye
maine 5000 rupaye ka electronic device kharida tha lekin packaging kharab thi abhi apko return form bhejna hai mujhe
agar mera refund jaldi process kar diya to mujhe dusra order bhi dena hai lekin abhi tak paise nahi mile

items.context: Can you explain the return policy and how long the process takes?
items.text: please mujhe bataye return policy kya hai aur return process kitna time lega

items.context: Did you receive a wrong size in your shirt order?
items.text: maine apke app se shirt order ki thi size galat aagaya hai kya iske liye refund milega

items.context: Will the pickup be arranged if the product is damaged or should I send it myself?
items.text: agar product damaged hai to kya aap log pickup arrange karte hain ya mujhe khud bhejna padega

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: delivery
Intent: return_refund - wants to return an item or asks about a refund
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with numbers (account and phone numbers, OTPs, amounts, dates) written as numerals, with long numbers spaced in groups the way people say them

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
